def _detect_minutes(query: str) -> int | None:
    q = normalize_text(query)
    # Word numbers are quantity slots only next to a duration unit. Preserve
    # identifiers and time of day; never rewrite the user's raw query.
    words = {'หนึ่ง':1,'สอง':2,'สาม':3,'สี่':4,'ห้า':5,'หก':6,
             'one':1,'two':2,'three':3,'four':4,'five':5,'six':6}
    word_match = re.search(r'(?<![a-z])('+'|'.join(words)+r')\s*(ชั่วโมง|ชม\.?|hours?|hrs?|นาที|minutes?|mins?)',q)
    if word_match:
        return words[word_match.group(1)] * (60 if re.match(r'ชั่วโมง|ชม|hour|hr',word_match.group(2)) else 1)
    if contains_alias(q, TIME_WORD_ALIASES["half_hour"], fuzzy=False)[0]:
        return 30
    if contains_alias(q, TIME_WORD_ALIASES["one_hour"], fuzzy=False)[0]:
        return 60

    hour_match = re.search(r"(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:ชั่วโมง|ชม|hour|hr)", q)
    if hour_match:
        return int(float(hour_match.group(1)) * 60)
    minute_match = re.search(r"(\d+)\s*(?:นาที|min|minutes?)", q)
    if minute_match:
        return int(minute_match.group(1))
    return None


def _mentions_vr_30_and_60(query: str) -> bool:

    mentions_60 = contains_alias(q, TIME_WORD_ALIASES["one_hour"], fuzzy=False)[0] or bool(re.search(r"\b(?:1|หนึ่ง)\s*(?:ชั่วโมง|ชม|hour|hr)", q)) or bool(re.search(r"\b60\s*(?:นาที|min|minutes?)", q))
    comparison = any(term in q for term in ["ต่างกัน", "เทียบ", "เปรียบเทียบ", "แพงกว่า", "ถูกกว่า", "กับ"])
    return mentions_30 and mentions_60 and comparison


def _detect_people(query: str) -> int | None:
    q = normalize_text(query)
    match = re.search(r'(\d+)\s*(?:คน|persons?|people|ppl)',q)
    if match:return int(match.group(1))
    words={'หนึ่ง':1,'สอง':2,'สาม':3,'สี่':4,'ห้า':5,'หก':6,'one':1,'two':2,'three':3,'four':4,'five':5,'six':6}
    match=re.search(r'(?<![a-z])('+'|'.join(words)+r')\s*(?:คน|persons?|people|ppl|of us)',q)
    if match:return words[match.group(1)]
    match=re.search(r'\bgroup of (one|two|three|four|five|six)\b',q)
    return words[match.group(1)] if match else None

def _sessions_for(service_key: str, requested_minutes: int | None) -> int:
    fee = SERVICE_FEES[service_key]

    return max(1, math.ceil(requested_minutes / int(fee["minutes_per_session"])))

        return f"•    {GROUP_LABELS[group_key]}: {_money(price)}/{fee['unit_label']}"

def make_source_hits(source_ids: list[str] | tuple[str, ...]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    hits: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for source_id in source_ids:
        if source_id in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(source_id)
        hits.append(make_source_hit(source_id))
    return hits
